drhp.business: Alldigi Tech Limited provides business process management (BPM) and technology & digital (T&D) services globally. BPM encompasses lead generation, customer retention, and relationship management including voice and non-voice processes, while T&D covers HRMS, payroll services, and time and attendance management. The company serves clients across 69 markets with a focus on embedding AI into operations and products.

drhp.expansion: The Company has 8 offices/service delivery centres in India located at Chennai, Bengaluru and Noida. Subsidiaries include Alldigi Tech Inc located in the USA (Bedminster, New Jersey) and Alldigi Tech Manila Inc in the Philippines (Taguig City). No specific new capex projects, capacity additions, or expansion timelines are disclosed in the provided annual report text.
